items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I discovered Ella Fitzgerald and I introduced her to Chick Webb... I'm the one that discovered her, but Chick Webb was the one who developed her.

ctx.x: got plenty of time to talk about your association with him. When did you find out about him being a master.

I went with -- I'm ahead of the story but in 1930, I went into the theatre, see, director of music. At the Lafayette, we went from the Lafayette into the Harlem Opera House, that's when I discovered Ella Fitzgerald and I introduced her to Chick Webb. Chick Webb exploit her, but I discovered her.
